title: Finite-Time Vanishing of Vacuum and Large-Time Behavior of the Multi-Dimensional Degenerate Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations with Large Spherically Symmetric Initial Data
summary: In this paper, we study the two- and three-dimensional barotropic compressible Navier-Stokes equations with degenerate density-dependent viscosity coefficients in the whole space or in a ball for arbitrarily large spherically symmetric initial data. For initial data allowing vacuum, we establish the global existence of weak solutions and derive uniform-in-time a priori estimates. As a consequence, we prove that the vacuum state of weak solutions will vanish in finite time.
